title: Rust's Tribonacci game-sequence identity
outcome: The actual greedy game sequences give X20=30,Y20=56,X56=86,Y30=84, so the asserted identity has sides170 and171 atn20. The complete infinite source construction and greedy/history/uniqueness bridges are proved.
